name: Blue Breaker ~Ken yori mo Hohoemi o~
original_name: ブルーブレイカー 〜剣よりも微笑みを〜
source:
The world of Blue Breaker is called "the path in the middle of empty sky": floating islands connected with each other by bridges. It is the tradition of the people in this world that a fighter's full initiation can be completed only when he finds his true love and marries her. Such day has come now in the life a young warrior named Kain, the hero of the game. His father explains to him that besides the usual warrior's goal of defeating the evil Dark Lord, Kain also has to find the girl of his dreams. He introduces to him a young sorceress named Asha, who becomes his first companion. But on his journey Kain meets many other young women, and it won't be so easy to choose one to whom he can give his heart!

Labeled as Love Role-Playing, "Blue Breaker" is a genre-crossing game that combines traditional Japanese RPG with town and dungeon exploration, party-based combat, etc., with "love adventure", in which your behavior towards girls influences the story. "Blue Breaker" features branching story progressing: events appear depending on the progress you have made with your female companions. Your typical RPG activities will influence your relationship with the girls. For example, if you fight too much, the girls will be tired; if you give a girl too many orders in battle (you can set battle in auto mode and only interfere occasionally) she will be displeased, and so on. It is also important to form a party in which the girls will have as few internal conflicts with each other as possible.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/playstation/blue-breaker-ken-yori-mo-hohoemi-o]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《BLUE BREAKER》的世界名为“虚空中央之路”，由一座座漂浮岛屿组成，岛屿之间以桥梁相连。这个世界流传着一项传统：战士唯有找到真爱并与她成婚，才算完成真正的成人礼。如今，游戏主人公、年轻战士凯因也迎来了这一天。父亲告诉他，除了打倒邪恶魔王这一常规使命外，他还必须找到自己的梦中情人。父亲把年轻女魔法师阿莎介绍给他，她也成了凯因最初的伙伴。然而旅途中，凯因还会遇见许多年轻女性；想要从中选出一位托付真心的人，可没那么容易！

《BLUE BREAKER》自称“恋爱角色扮演游戏”，是一部跨类型作品。它把日式角色扮演游戏常见的城镇与迷宫探索、队伍战斗等内容，同会因玩家对待少女的方式而改变剧情的“恋爱冒险”结合起来。游戏采用分支式剧情，事件会依照玩家与女性伙伴的关系进展出现。传统角色扮演游戏中的行动也会影响少女对凯因的态度。例如，战斗太多会令她们疲惫；若在战斗中对某位少女下达过多命令——玩家可以让战斗自动进行，只在必要时介入——她也会感到不满。组队时同样要多加留心，尽量避免让彼此容易发生冲突的少女待在同一队伍中。
